Quantum-Resistant Address
On KasSigner, open the KCC-3 address you want and scan its QR code. Its key stays on the unit until the address spends.

This send puts this address\'s key on chain, so its change can\'t come back here. Add an unused quantum-resistant address from KasSigner first (a change address, #0 to #4, is best), or send the whole balance.
Compounding puts this address\'s key on chain, so its coins move to an unused quantum-resistant address of this account. Add one from KasSigner first (a change address, #0 to #4, is best).
Stop Watching This Address?
Its %1$s KAS stay on chain at this address, on your KasSigner; K only stops showing them. Scan the address again from KasSigner to watch it again.
Edit Address Number
The number and chain KasSigner shows for this address.
Chain

The number KasSigner shows for this address, and whether it is a receive or a change address. With it the unit finds the key at once when signing; without it the unit searches for it. KasSigner marks change sent to its change addresses #0 to #4 as change; any other address it shows as a payment.
That number is too large: KasSigner\'s address numbers are below 2147483648.
Moves all of this address\'s coins into one, at an unused quantum-resistant address of this account: this transaction puts this address\'s key on chain.
This address holds more coins than one transaction can spend: %1$d stay behind the key this send puts on chain. Send them on in another transaction right after.

Sign Without the Address Number
If KasSigner refuses this request, the address number may be wrong. Without it, the unit looks for the address itself. Edit Address Number puts it right for next time.
Combines all UTXOs at this address into one at an unused quantum-resistant address of this account, since this puts this address\'s key on chain.
